title: Colliquation

inlines.v: COLLIQUATION, noun 1. The act of melting. 2. A dissolving, flowing or wasting; applied to the blood, when it does not readily coagulate, and to the solid parts, when they waste away by excessive secretion, occasioning fluxes and profuse, clammy sweats.
